label: Test strictness and ties in independently supplied inclusive perfection coverage
meaning: The candidate degree is the pure-perfection coverage set from the same inclusive ActFrame; it does not consult limitation or the desired source order. Completeness of c is an explicit internal hypothesis, not inferred from source naming or represented identity. Strict inclusion needs a pure perfection x lacks even inclusively; an equally complete x ties c. Explicit excluded middle extracts a witness from proper inclusion. This neither supplies an actual missing witness nor proves a limited bearer incomplete. Binary repertoire coverage can omit intensity and so is not automatically a faithful esse-fullness measure.
